about: The expected values of the fixture run of each attested computation this capability carries,
one entry per skill. Every number here is quoted from the Reference run section of the concept
named in `concept`, which this package owns and which the move of 2026-09-20 left at status
draft pending the maintainer's re-sign: the fixture exists so the golden fails when a chain
stops reproducing what the concept records, not so that a number can be asserted here.
The run identifier of a fixture run is bound to the runtime name and to the package the run is
evidence for, so it is deliberately not asserted; the values below are the same under any name.
